rounds.notes: Pipeline structure and sequence are preserved, but the background is inverted to black, the vertical ellipses rendered as missing character boxes, and photographic patches are replaced with abstract shapes.

The reconstruction correctly captures the logical pipeline and architectural components of MAE. However, the background is black instead of white, rendering the 'Input' and 'Target' labels almost illegible, and the photograph patches are substituted with simplified geometric approximations.

findings.problem: The encoded tokens column (cyan rectangles) has an unwanted gap in the middle with only 7 tokens instead of 8 contiguous tokens matching the 8 visible patches.
findings.cause: The token at y=129 was omitted between enc_t_3 (y=106) and enc_t_4 (y=152), leaving an empty space.

findings.fix: Add the missing cyan rectangle at x="220" y="129" width="23" height="21" so all 8 tokens form a continuous column.

findings.problem: Vertical dots in the sequence columns render as missing character glyph boxes (tofu) instead of vertical ellipsis dots.
findings.cause: The unicode character ⋮ is used in a standard serif font that does not support it.
findings.code_fragment: <text id="dec_in_dots" data-id="dec_in_dots" data-class="composite_part" data-parent="decoder_input_seq" x="290" y="196" text-anchor="middle" font-family="serif" font-size="14" fill="#555555">⋮</text>
findings.fix: Replace ⋮ with three separate dot circles or standard periods formatted vertically, or use font-family="sans-serif" with supported characters.

rounds.notes: Excellent structural and layout reconstruction. The flamingo photograph in the input, patch stream, and target was replaced with an abstract geometric illustration, but all architectural pipeline components, tokens, arrows, and labels are accurately represented.

findings.problem: Missing white background rectangle causes dark text labels ('Input', 'Target', and vertical dots) to be almost illegible against dark backgrounds.
findings.cause: The SVG lacks a root background `<rect width="100%" height="100%" fill="#ffffff"/>`.
findings.fix: Add a white background rectangle at the beginning of the SVG: `<rect width="100%" height="100%" fill="#ffffff"/>`.
